task_description: Build a fully functional copy trading dashboard for managing funding company accounts, creating copy groups with configurable risk, viewing metrics, and connecting with Tradovate and other platforms. Full-stack Next.js 14 app with serverless backend, Google auth, and modern responsive UI.

verification.summary: Build succeeds cleanly (only unused variable warnings for interface stubs). All 115 tests pass across 6 test files covering: utility functions, trading account validation schemas, adapter factory, copy engine risk calculations, copy group validation schemas, and metrics calculations. Tests exercise real business logic with meaningful assertions.
